preconditioner.type: independent primal mode-block Jacobi; identity on gauge multipliers

decision: Reject. Independent mode-block primal solves leave the multiplier/gauge coupling poorly scaled; the true linear residual is far above tolerance. Do not raise the iteration budget blindly.
limitations: This is a linear preconditioner diagnostic only; it does not apply a correction or report a polished equilibrium.
Mode blocks are assembled locally from force Jacobians; the full coupled Jacobian is not formed.
